note: Top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, search box, 'New project' button, dashboard shortcut labels (Issues, Merge requests, To do list), Help, and user avatar controls

Project sidebar navigation -- renders: fixed section labels (Project information, Repository, Issues, Merge requests, Pipelines, Deployments, Infrastructure, Monitor, Analytics, Wiki, Snippets, Settings); the project name header is subtracted as it is user-defined
Breadcrumb navigation -- renders: user-defined project and namespace names, which are treated as trusted navigation context in this calibration

Merge request list controls -- renders: state tabs (Opened, Merged, Closed, All), 'New merge request' button, sort and filter controls, and bulk update actions; the list of merge requests and the search input are subtracted
